vision.model: vision_any/2 (multi-year NAIP + lidar point statistics, LightGBM on hand maps; lidar canopy edge buffer)
vision.trained_on: hand maps of Spirit Hollow (hand_zones_ll.json) and Mozingo Lake (tee_strategy.HOLES)
vision.trees: 3DEP lidar HAG > 2.5 m; Meta CHM in 2.1% lidar gaps; golfer trees line = canopy (HAG > 2.5 m, clumps >= 100 m2) buffered -1 m (learned on the hand maps)
vision.native: no long grass (native) layer: off by decision, not a missing setting: no P(native) threshold beat 'no long grass' on held-out truth courses (v2_decision_calibration.md, v2_holdout_calibration.md, v2_longgrass_cv.md, v2_longgrass_cv_rev2.md; out-of-fold corridor recall 0.01-0.11, false long grass on courses with none: v2_longgrass_eb.md)
vision.water: OSM water + NDWI open water near OSM water/streams + DTM channel of OSM streams + unmown banks
vision.lidar: 3DEP point cloud (EPT/PDAL) per-1 m return statistics: USGS_LPC_KS_SCentral_L1_2015_LAS_2017, KS_DouglasCounty_2006

Pixel frame per hole: px = pixel.tee_px + pixel.ppy * (x, y) (920 x 2000, the image / book frame).
